notes: Validated against Huang et al. Nat Chem Biol 2014 (doi:10.1038/nchembio.1561) and Ferré-D'Amaré et al. Nat Methods 2014. 4Q9R: Spinach aptamer bound to 2ZY (TO1-Biotin analog / difluoro-hydroxyphenyl-imidazolinone). BINDING MECHANISM: DFHBI/2ZY stacks between G26 and G65 of the top G-quartet in an unusual G-quadruplex topology. U61·A64 base triple below the G-quartet provides the binding platform floor. G14 is extruded into solvent and partially encloses the phenyl ring face. The G-quadruplex motif locks the fluorophore in a planar conformation, restricting photoisomerisation and activating fluorescence. 4Q9R uses chain A (2 chains in structure). Note: 2ZY is a TO1-Biotin analog — different scaffold from DFHBI but same binding mechanism.
